title: Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan On Limiting Greenhouse Gas Emissions (No. O'RQ-1073)
citation: Law No. O'RQ-1073 (Russian ZRU-1073) of 7 July 2025
evidence: Lex.uz card of the act: "Дата вступления в силу 09.01.2026"; Art. 29: "Настоящий Закон вступает в силу по истечении шести месяцев со дня его официального опубликования." and "Часть пятая статьи 18 настоящего Закона вводится в действие с 1 января 2027 года." Opened https://lex.uz/ru/docs/7618153 on 2026-11-03.
notes: Replaces the gov.uz news page (https://gov.uz/en/imv/news/view/67755) as the official URL in the register row. Framework law: state accounting of emissions (Art. 11), targets (Art. 12), "green" projects (Art. 13), carbon unit registry (Art. 14) and trading (Art. 15), monitoring, reporting and verification (Arts. 17 to 19), regulated organisations (Art. 23); Art. 8 names the Ministry of Economy and Finance. Part five of Art. 18 applies from 2027-01-01; the 2027-01-01 edition on Lex.uz has the same text as the 2026-01-09 edition, so the two records are identical. Stored: uz only (2 records, Uzbek Cyrillic, document 7616051). The Russian text (document 7618153) carries the Lex.uz label «Неофициальный перевод» in both editions, so it is not stored under a pass row (UZ-LEXUZ-TRANSLATION, permission requested). English: no government English text exists for this instrument; looked for on Lex.uz (the English page of the act carries only a notice that the text is given in Uzbek and Russian and points to the site's unofficial online translation, row UZ-LEXUZ-TRANSLATION, permission requested, nothing stored). No implementing Cabinet resolution was found on Lex.uz by title search on 2026-11-03.

title: Decree of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan No. UP-110 On measures for participation in the international carbon units market
citation: Decree of the President No. UP-110 (Uzbek PF-110) of 7 July 2025
evidence: Lex.uz card of the act: "Дата вступления в силу 08.07.2025"; the text ends "г. Both records are the first and only edition, kind adopted. title: Resolution of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan No. PP-213 On measures to introduce the national transparency system in the transition to a green economy
citation: Resolution of the President No. PP-213 of 5 June 2024
evidence: Lex.uz card of the act: "Дата вступления в силу 06.06.2024". Opened https://lex.uz/ru/docs/6956104 on 2026-11-03.
notes: Introduces the national transparency system for greenhouse gas reporting under Art. 13 of the Paris Agreement; its annex amends Resolution No. PP-436 of 2 December 2022 (green economy programme), which is not in scope, and sets up an Interagency Council. One version only. Languages stored: uz (document 6956101) and ru (document 6956104). The Concept of the system (Cabinet Resolution No. 800 of 30 November 2024, https://lex.uz/ru/docs/7248680) is a plan and is not in scope. title: Resolution of the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Uzbekistan No. 221 On measures to introduce the principles of sustainable development and environmental, social and corporate governance (ESG)
citation: Resolution of the Cabinet of Ministers No. 221 of 4 May 2026
evidence: Uzbek text, item 7: "Ушбу қарор 2026 йил 1 июлдан эътиборан кучга киради."; Lex.uz card of the Russian page: "Дата вступления в силу 01.07.2026". Opened https://lex.uz/docs/8171367 and https://lex.uz/ru/docs/8181642 on 2026-11-03.
notes: Annex 1 sets rules for reporting under the international financial reporting standards and the sustainability disclosure standards; annex 2 is the programme for state-participated enterprises in transformation, which apply the rules from 2026-07-01 and move to the disclosure standards in stages. Items 4 and following ask for voluntary introduction by companies whose securities trade on the Tashkent Republican Stock Exchange by 2027-01-01 (about 50 local enterprises, voluntary reporting from the 2027 reporting period). This is the only sustainability disclosure instrument found; no rule of the National Agency of Perspective Projects or the Tashkent Stock Exchange was found (see the report). One version only. Stored: uz only (document 8171367, Uzbek original). The Russian page (document 8181642) holds the title, date and signature only (251 characters, no text), so no Russian record exists. English: no government English text exists for this instrument; looked for on Lex.uz (the English page of the act carries only a notice that the text is given in Uzbek and Russian and points to the site's unofficial online translation, row UZ-LEXUZ-TRANSLATION, permission requested, nothing stored).
